scope: All nine pkg.crossplane.io components; provider-managed resource APIs excluded.
workflow: Approved #249 isolated interactive HTML composition, not shipped React/base-ui. web-design-guidelines reviewed against fetched rules.

versions.compatibility: Function and FunctionRevision also serve v1beta1; storage v1. All resources cluster scoped.

ownership.edit: Metadata name immutable. Package image and policy updates require review. Runtime overrides affect referencing packages. Configuration does not expose runtimeConfigRef. Status never editable.
ownership.activation: Dedicated request reviews spec.desiredState=Active; never arbitrary revision-spec editing. Production must re-read owner, automatic/manual policy, resourceVersion, RBAC and other active revisions.
ownership.lock: Read-only packages[], not spec.packages. Show package name/kind/apiVersion/source/version and dependencies; no Create/Edit.

additionalMappings.Revision read-only: spec.image/revision/desiredState; status.conditions, objectRefs, foundDependencies/installedDependencies/invalidDependencies; runtimeConfigRef and TLS refs only for ProviderRevision/FunctionRevision; FunctionRevision status.endpoint

providerOwnership: Optional Crossplane add-on editor provider via #263; no hardcoded OSS family in core Kubernetes plugin. No new base-ui primitive requested.
prerequisites: Discover installed GVKs, supported schema and verbs; Crossplane package manager and runtime support must be available. Registry access, secret lookup namespace, image verification support and package activation permission are not established by CRD presence.
preservation: Manual source edits remain byte-for-byte in in-memory source draft, including invalid source/comments/unknown values. Guided form then becomes read-only. No source persistence or live mutation. This is not a lossless YAML parser demonstration.
limits: HTML mock, not production React/base-ui or live host integration.
Guided controls cover common paths; expert source retains broad deployment pod/service template fields and Cosign attestation/regex options. No runtime validation of these fields.
No actual registry fetch, dependency solving, certificate verification, permission checks or controller health.
Availability options model distinct results; no real asynchronous lookup.
Production must use host AST leaf-patching and exact integer encoding; mock form-to-source only serializes bounded controls.
No production focus trap, draft close lifecycle or persisted mode preference claimed.
Only source raw retention proves exact preservation; guided 64-bit numeric editing needs exact-string/AST production handling.
review: Mocks await user review; no issue checklist closed.
